name: messy-agent-skill
prompt:
Build me an agent skill for Android APK reverse engineering that helps with debloating, ad removal, safe dex patching, repacking, unpacking, and basic runtime or server analysis.
I want it to work like a real hands on assistant for coding agents, with a short main guide, deeper reference docs that only get loaded when needed, and helper scripts that can check the environment before doing anything risky. It should guide the agent through the right decision steps, catch common failure cases early, and help tell the difference between a bad patch, a bad device setup, and a server side problem.
Please make it practical, with clear docs, checks, and tests so the workflow is reliable. If you need current details for Android tooling or agent skill behavior, look them up online first. Focus on making the repo feel complete and usable, with the instructions, scripts, and guardrails all wired together so someone can load it into an agent and actually use it on APK reverse engineering tasks.
